defects: The 'À RETENIR / l'Aâsser, la prière de l'après-midi' didactic card from the previous scene is still visible at the top center over the opening painting of scene 12.

defects: The dellal still keeps both hands cupped in front of his mouth/chin rather than dangling the pair of bracelets high from his right hand, and his mouth is not wide open.
tiles.fix: Hold the dellal's right hand high with the dangling bracelets and keep his mouth wide open while shouting the figure.

defects: The father's right hand and the dellal's right hand clip through each other at chest height with no visible pair of bracelets being passed between them.
The father gazes at the dellal's face instead of looking down at the bracelets, while the dellal's head stays tilted back staring at the ceiling.

defects: Both the father and the dellal have dropped their arms straight down to their sides empty-handed instead of the father holding and examining the bracelets at chest height.
The father looks straight ahead and the dellal still stares up at the ceiling.
tiles.fix: Keep the father's hands raised at chest height holding the pair of bracelets with his gaze pitched down at them, and bring the dellal's head down to look at the father.

defects: Zoubida's white haik is a closed armless cone with only disembodied fingertips poking through the solid front cloth—neither her wrists nor the bracelets are visible.
Fatma's hands are raised to her face and clip through her white litham veil instead of trying the bracelets on her wrist, while the dellal remains frozen staring at the ceiling.
tiles.fix: Expose Zoubida's and Fatma's forearms/wrists outside the haik folds so they visibly slip the bracelets onto their wrists, and fix the dellal's frozen upward gaze.

defects: In the closer medium crop, Zoubida's fingertips poke straight through the solid chest mesh of her white haik with no wrists or bracelets visible, and Fatma's hands clip through her face veil.
The dellal on the right is sliced by the frame edge leaving only the tip of his nose/beard and sleeve protruding into the shot, and Mohammed looks backward off-screen left.
tiles.fix: Animate proper wrist-trying gestures with visible hands and bracelets outside the haik mesh, turn Mohammed toward his mother, and widen or shift the crop so the dellal is not sliced at the right edge.

defects: The father's right hand is a low curled fist against his chest rather than a clear raised two-finger signal, and the boy in green stands directly in front of him obstructing the view.
Zoubida and Fatma remain frozen with their fingers clipping through their haik/veil, and the dellal still stands with his arms down staring at the ceiling.
tiles.fix: Raise the father's hand clearly with two fingers extended, move the foreground boy out of the sightline, relax Zoubida's and Fatma's arms, and turn the dellal toward the father to receive the signal.

defects: As the dellal walks away up the lane, both of his arms hang down at his sides instead of holding his right hand with the bracelets high above his head over the crowd as required by the brief and subtitle ('Sa main seule voyagea un moment au-dessus des têtes, avec les bracelets').
The insert of the hand carrying the bracelets above the heads is missing, and Zoubida's fingers still poke through her closed white haik.
tiles.fix: Raise the retreating dellal's right arm straight up above his head holding the bracelets over the crowd and cut to or frame the insert of his raised hand travelling above the heads.

worst_problem: Across beats b079–b082, the central bracelet business completely fails: Zoubida's and Fatma's hands clip through solid haik/veil meshes without visible wrists or bracelets, the father's hand-off and two-finger signal are missing or reverted to idle poses, and the dellal remains stuck staring at the ceiling before walking away with his arms down instead of holding the bracelets high above the crowd.
